name: Shipyard Planner
pitch: A planning app for Claude Code projects: brief, features, a session-sized plan, a ready CLAUDE.md, and a health check to keep improving.
audience: Me (Hunter), when I start or keep going on a project built with Claude Code.
problem: Projects drift without a clear goal, tasks get too big for one Claude session, and lessons from past sessions get lost.
doneWhen: I can take an idea to a brief, a feature list and a step-by-step plan, copy a good prompt for each task into Claude Code, and keep a CLAUDE.md that improves as I learn.
stack:
Single HTML page hosted as a private Claude artifact
Vanilla JavaScript, no build step
Artifact database for saving projects
Claude (inside the page) for drafting and reviews
commands: # No build step: open shipyard.html in a browser and try the change in light, dark and phone widths
conventions:
- Keep it one HTML file
- Every Claude feature must be optional; the app works without it
- Plain, friendly wording in the interface
constraints: Runs inside claude.ai with no server of its own.

features.title: Project brief
features.detail: Pitch, audience, problem, finish line, stack, commands and conventions.

features.title: Feature board
features.detail: Must, should and could lanes with a status on each feature.

features.title: Milestone plan
features.detail: Milestones in order, each broken into tasks sized S, M or L.

features.title: Prompt for each task
features.detail: Turns any task into a ready-to-paste Claude Code prompt with project context.

features.title: CLAUDE.md builder
features.detail: Generated from the project, editable, copy or download.

features.title: Health checks and lessons
features.detail: Automatic plan checks, good habits, and lessons that become CLAUDE.md rules.

features.title: Claude drafting and review
features.detail: Draft a brief and plan from an idea, suggest features, review the project.

features.title: Export as Markdown
features.detail: The whole plan as one Markdown file.

features.title: Project templates
features.detail: Start from a template for common project types such as a website, a game or a bot.

features.title: Import an existing CLAUDE.md
features.detail: Paste a CLAUDE.md from a repo and fill the brief from it.

screens.name: Project list
screens.notes: Left rail with every project, its stage and task progress.

screens.name: Project sheet
screens.notes: Name, stage, build gauge and five tabs: Overview, Design, Plan, CLAUDE.md, Improve.

decisions.text: Host the app as a private Claude artifact instead of a GitHub repo.
decisions.why: No setup, it saves to my account, and Claude can read my plans when I ask for help.

milestones.goal: Plan a project end to end inside the app.

tasks.title: Build brief, feature board and plan
Add health checks, lessons and Claude review
Test in light, dark and phone layouts

milestones.title: First version

tasks.notes: Add an Import CLAUDE.md option to the New project dialog that fills the pitch, stack, commands and conventions from a pasted file's sections. Check: pasting this project's own CLAUDE.md fills the brief.
tasks.title: Import an existing CLAUDE.md into a new project

milestones.goal: Use Shipyard for one real Claude Code build and note what feels clunky.

tasks.notes: Use New project, then Create and draft with Claude.
tasks.title: Create a project for my next Claude Code idea

Ask Claude in the project chat to fix the top three annoyances

milestones.title: Try it on a real project
